_note: Every number here is an unverified placeholder. Change values here, not in code. Shared by the web build and the future Roblox port.

lapIncome._note: Paid on reaching or passing New Year, before property tax and Banker interest. Prorated: amount x min(1, squares walked forward since the last payout / board size), rounded down to roundDownTo. Only forward moves along the track count (dice, cards that move you forward); flights, sailing, swaps and backward moves do not. The count resets at each payout and anything above one board length is not carried over.

roundLimit._note: Rounds before the richest player (net worth) wins. 0 = play until one player is left. 4-bot simulations run a median of about 140 rounds without a limit.

rent._levelMultipliersNote: Index = building level: 0 empty lot, 1-4 houses, 5 hotel.
rent._sectionBonusCountsNote: citiesAndUtilities = 12 squares, so 11 extra squares hit the +110% cap. Set to cities to count the 8 cities only (cap then tops out at +70%).

utilities._requiresCityInSectionNote: If true, a meter only earns fees while its owner owns at least one city in that section. Otherwise the fee goes to the bank.

airports._flightBandsNote: A flight's band comes from the great-circle distance between the two airports' seas (first band whose maxKm it fits). The band of every airport pair is generated into data/board.json flights.

seaports._note: Routes between seaports are in data/board.json seaRoutes (drawn in data/layout.json; authored in scripts/world.mjs).

disasters._note: Degrade: every developed property in the section loses 1 level. Destroy: each owner in the section loses all buildings on their most developed property there. No refunds.
